Boot and halt utility services, plus a hosted poll syscall wrapper.

# Purpose
This header file defines the main public interface for the `fd_util` utility layer. It includes the core utility headers used by default, such as `rng/fd_rng.h`, `spad/fd_spad.h`, `alloc/fd_alloc.h`, `sandbox/fd_sandbox.h`, and `bits/fd_sat.h`, and it lists many other optional utility headers in comments. The file declares [`fd_boot`](<#fd_boot>) and [`fd_halt`](<#fd_halt>), which start and stop the utility services and also process command line and environment options for logging, shared memory, and CPU or thread placement. For hosted targets, it also declares [`fd_syscall_poll`](<#fd_syscall_poll>), a wrapper that standardizes `poll` behavior by using `ppoll` on Linux when needed.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_boot`
- `fd_halt`
- `fd_syscall_poll`
